# War Scroll Column 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 3 | **Condition:** complete

---

**3:1** And upon the great standard which-is at-the-head of all-the-people they-shall-write: "People-of God," and the names-of Israel and Aaron, and the names-of the twelve tribes-of Israel

**3:2** according-to their generations. And upon the standard-of the heads of the camps of-the-three tribes they-shall-write: [...] and the name of the chief-of the camp

**3:3** and the names-of the chiefs-of its thousands, and the names-of the chiefs-of its hundreds, and on-his-standard: the standard-of the tribe. They-shall-write: "Standard-of God [...]"

**3:4** and the name-of the chief-of the tribe and the names-of the chiefs-of its ten-thousands and the names-of the chiefs-of its thousands.

**3:5** And upon the standard-of the ten-thousand they-shall-write: "Wrath-of God is-kindled against Belial and against all the men-of his lot, without-any-remnant,"

**3:6** and the name-of the chief-of the ten-thousand and the names-of the chiefs-of its thousands. And upon the standard-of the thousand they-shall-write:

**3:7** "The-Anger-of God is-full against the Sons-of-Darkness; he shall-not-turn-back his anger until they-are-annihilated," and the name-of the chief-of the thousand

**3:8** and the names-of the chiefs-of its hundreds. And upon the standard-of the hundred they-shall-write: "From-God is the hand-of war against all

**3:9** flesh-of wickedness," and the name-of the chief-of the hundred and the names-of the chiefs-of its tens. And upon the standard-of the fifty they-shall-write:

**3:10** "Ended is the stand-of wickedness by the might-of God," and the name-of the chief-of the fifty and the names-of the chiefs-of its tens.

**3:11** And upon the standard-of the ten they-shall-write: "Songs-of-joy for God upon the ten-stringed harp," and the name-of the chief-of the ten and the names

**3:12** of the nine men-of his command. And when they go-forth to-battle they-shall-write upon their standards: "Truth-of God," "Righteousness-of God,"

**3:13** "Glory-of God," "Justice-of God," and after-these the whole order-of their names. And when they draw-near to-battle they-shall-write upon their standards:

**3:14** "Right-hand-of God," "Appointed-time-of God," "Tumult-of God," "Slain-ones-of God." And after-these the whole-order-of their names.

**3:15** And when they return from-battle they-shall-write upon their standards: "Exaltation-of God," "Greatness-of God," "Praises-of God," "Glory-of God,"

**3:16** with the whole-order-of their names. The rule-of the standards-of the congregation: When they go-forth to-battle they-shall-write upon the first standard:

**3:17** "Congregation-of God"; upon the second standard: "Camps-of God"; upon the third: "Tribes-of God"; upon the fourth: "Clans-of God";

---

*EMET notes: Column 3 details the inscriptions on military standards (banners). Every unit from the entire people down to the ten-man squad has its own standard with a distinctive theological inscription. The progression from assembly through battle to return creates a liturgical arc. "Songs-of-joy" (3:11) echoes Psalm 92:4 (ten-stringed instrument). All inscriptions rendered as hyphenated construct chains.*
